hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *"git diff --staged"*|*"git diff --cached"*) touch "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.git/.claude_commit_marker" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; true
